DA_Sorted_partial: Stored $1 items in $2 chests, $3 left in the box
DA_Sort_waiting: Waiting on chests another player has - filing shortly
DA_storage_waiting: Some of the materials are in a chest another player has - try again in a moment
DA_shared_changed: Someone else got to that first
DA_shared_failed: The chest did not respond - nothing was moved
DA_Sorted_returned: $1 items did not fit in an open chest and were returned
DA_craft_from_storage_on: On. Crafting, upgrading, Hammer building and enchanting spend what you carry first, then draw the rest from the AutoSorter's linked chests.
DA_craft_from_storage_off: Off. Only what you are carrying counts, as if no AutoSorter were in range.
DA_craft_from_storage_hint: Click to switch. This is your own setting - it changes nothing for anyone else.
DA_deposit_selected_desc: Moves the item types selected under [C] into the Autosorter and files them away. Equipped gear always stays on you.
DA_deposit_quickslots_kept: Your quick slots stay on you.
DA_deposit_quickslots_in: Your quick slots are deposited too.
DA_filter_quickslots_note: Equipment slots and slots added by other mods always stay on you.
DA_filter_partial: Some of these are kept, as set in the config file.
DA_deposit_hopper_desc: Moves wood and ore from your pack into the Hopper, ready for its kilns and smelters. Equipped items stay on you.
DA_Deposit_box_full: No room left in the deposit box
DA_Deposit_hopper_full: No room left in the Hopper
DA_hopper_targets_none_desc: Nothing the Hopper can service is within $1m. Build a smelter, kiln or other processing station nearby, or add Surtling Cores to reach further.
DA_seek_desc: Lists everything in the chests around it, to search through and take from. Black Cores in its pillars let it reach further.
DA_seek_dormant: Dormant - set a Black Core into one of its pillars
DA_seek_disabled: The Seeking Table is turned off on this server
DA_seek_capped: Too many to show - narrow the search
DA_seek_gone: Someone else got to that first
DA_seek_lost: The chest did not answer - if it does, the items will still arrive
DA_seek_refused: That chest would not hand it over
DA_seek_busy: That chest is changing hands - try again in a moment
DA_seek_unreadable: Something came back that this game does not know - see the log
DA_seek_ground_on: On. Items lying on the ground within range are listed too, and taken from where they lie.
DA_seek_ground_off: Off. Only chests, boats and carts are listed.
DA_seek_ground_click: Click to switch. This is your own setting - it changes nothing for anyone else.
DA_seek_in_chest_ground: In 1 chest and on the ground ($1)
DA_seek_in_chests_ground: In $1 chests and on the ground ($2)
DA_grinder_desc: Breaks crafted items back down into part of what they cost: fill its hopper and pull the lever. Molten Cores in its power panel make it faster and return more.
DA_grinder_output_full: The results chest is full - empty it to carry on
DA_grinder_waiting: Waiting - the results chest is open
DA_grinder_idle: Put crafted items in the hopper and pull the lever to break them down
DA_grinder_pull_lever: Pull the lever to grind what is in the hopper
DA_grinder_loading: Loading the hopper - waiting for it to be closed
DA_grinder_stuck: What is queued was made by a mod this game no longer has
DA_grinder_disabled: The Grinder is turned off on this server
DA_grinder_nocraftcost: Nothing to grind for - crafting is free in this world
DA_lighter_desc: Keeps the fires, torches, braziers, ovens and hot tubs around it fuelled from its tank.
DA_lighter_disabled: The Lighter is turned off on this server
